landscapeMeasures.title: Cereblon has the largest target-linked active-trial set
landscapeMeasures.detail: The set contains 5 classified active assets and 116 distinct lead sponsors in ClinicalTrials.gov.

landscapeMeasures.title: Proteasome has the highest target-linked literature count
landscapeMeasures.detail: Count from reviewed title/abstract terms within the 2024–2026 PubMed window; target query results can overlap.

landscapeMeasures.title: NIH RePORTER returned 60 FY2026 records
landscapeMeasures.detail: Award amounts are summed from retrieved disease-title project records for the stated fiscal year; source status shows when those records were last retrieved.

landscapeMeasures.title: Share of active trials attributed to the five largest lead sponsors
landscapeMeasures.detail: The denominator is 906 active interventional studies across 352 distinct registered lead sponsors.

landscapeMeasures.title: Registered primary-completion dates within the next 18 months
landscapeMeasures.detail: Dates are sponsor-submitted estimates from ClinicalTrials.gov and can be revised.

landscapeMeasures.title: Countries with a registered site in at least one active study
landscapeMeasures.detail: The United States appears on 475 active studies; counts depend on registry location completeness.

methodology: Target rows count distinct active interventional studies and linked intervention entities, registered lead sponsors, target-linked PubMed query counts, and title-matched NIH project records. A study can appear under several targets. Source counts are not measures of clinical or commercial value.
